text_block_list.text:
—Christmas. In the West, spending it 
quietly with family seems to be the norm, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Just the two of us, Trainer... Spending 
Christmas... quietly together...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This is... the same as usual, right?

For the two of us who always spend our 
time quietly, it was meaningless. We 
decided to have dinner out for a change.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The Christmas dinner... was delicious, 
wasn't it? The tartness of the cranberries 
was quite nice too...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... shall we order one more piece of 
gingerbread? And also...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The dessert on the menu looked so cute... 
If it's okay, could I order it...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is... something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... Ah... It's just normal, though...

I had somehow gotten a gloomy impression 
of her, but having dinner together like 
this, she doesn't seem that way at all.

"Had she changed while we worked together, 
or was this simply who she was all along?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... have you ever been to 
Manhattan...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A city that shares my name... I've never 
been there myself, though...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I do find myself yearning for it a little. 
A snowy... Manhattan...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If only I could see such a sight, even 
just once...

—America. Indeed, it might feel like a 
distant place to horse girls.

I wouldn't mind going as a replacement for 
the overseas expedition that was called 
off back then, but—
choice_data_list:
But dirt tracks are the mainstream in 
America, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... Dirt...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Manhattan... Christmas... Dirt... Race...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's not... an expedition, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um, are you... joking?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a race, I'd like to do some 
sightseeing in Manhattan. Sipping mocktail 
fizzes, watching the celebrities stroll 
by...

"Even the dreams she talked about were 
quite ordinary. It was a Christmas where I 
got to see the true, unadorned Manhattan 
Cafe."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a race, I'd like to do some 
sightseeing in Manhattan. Sipping mocktail 
fizzes, watching the celebrities stroll 
by...
choice_data_list:
You wanna go gawk at some celebs or 
something?

Wanna go check out some celebrities or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm a little... interested. In the 
ones who shine the brightest... in the 
city that shares my name.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's fine... Even if I'm looking from the 
corner of my eye, there's absolutely no 
way they'll notice.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
People have always told me I have zero 
presence, so nobody ever notices me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No one, no one...

Just then, a group wearing Umamusume caps 
walked past the open-air cafe.

"Manhattan Cafe is a famous Umamusume now. 
It might be troublesome if she gets 
swarmed by fans, though..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry, Trainer. No 
one... noticed...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I am... but a shadow, after all...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Huh, isn't that Manhattan Cafe over there?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right. That looks super fun!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Nobody notices. Nobody...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
And it's just the two of us! Doesn't it 
feel a little romantic?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Could this be a Christmas date?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No one... notices... No... one...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's totally bright red.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
She's blushing, how cute...! I'm gonna 
become even more of a fan~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: They've... noticed me...

When you become this famous, it's hard to 
even conceal your presence. Manhattan 
Cafe's notoriety was now practically on 
par with a celebrity's.
